ns2:course.label: Space, Time, and Matter
ns2:course.description: (PHYCS 319) Philosophical examination of some fundamental concepts and theories of the physical world, such as time, matter, causation, space, and geometry; interpretation of quantum theory. Graduate students write an additional paper Same as PHIL 419. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing, one physical science course, and one of the following: PHYS 214 or PHIL 101, PHIL 270, or PHIL 317; or consent of instructor.
